name: Schlep-engine-monorepo
description: Schlep-engine - The Data Schlep Handler. We handle the schlep so you don't have to

scripts.dev:clean: pnpm --parallel --filter "@Schlep-engine/*" -- "pnpm run clean && pnpm run dev"
scripts.build:clean: pnpm --parallel --filter "@Schlep-engine/*" -- "pnpm run clean && pnpm run build"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,admin -c cyan,green "cd packages/backend && pip install -r requirements.txt && pip install --quiet aiomysql && uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000 --host 0.0.0.0" "pnpm --filter @Schlep-engine/admin dev -p 3002"
scripts.start: concurrently -n backend,admin -c cyan,green "cd packages/backend && uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000 --host 0.0.0.0" "pnpm --filter @Schlep-engine/admin start -p 3002"

author: Schlep-engine Team
